description: Prices a basket of store items for the person whose grant you hold and saves it with its pricing model, shipping, store tax estimate, fee and total. for them to review. THIS BUYS NOTHING AND MOVES NO MONEY. The answer carries `state`: approval_required with a reviewUrl, the page on Escrova where the person checks every line, approves and pays from their own wallet. Give them that link and stop: you cannot approve or pay. A signed-out person signs in on that page and continues with the same order. Send items, and to choose where it goes send the addressId of one of their saved addresses from list_addresses; with none their default is used. A typed address, a marketplace listing, a gift, an item whose condition is not new and a quantity that is not a whole number are refused. The grant needs the `buy` scope. Other states: not_started (refused, nothing was prepared; read the body) or reconciliation_required (outcome unknown; ask the person before preparing it again). Available to every shopper on mainnet. Bind the challenge to POST /api/agent/checkout-intents, over the body this tool sends, with delegationGrantId in targetArguments.

addressId.description: An id from list_addresses, read under the same grant. Omit for the person's default.

delegationGrantId.description: The grant of the person this order is for, from get_delegation. Required: without one there is nobody to ask.

gift.description: Refused: a gift is made by the person at checkout.

listingId.description: Refused: only store items can be prepared here, not a marketplace listing.

shippingAddress.description: Refused: an order can only go to an address the person saved. Send addressId instead.

signature.description: base58 ed25519 signature over the exact message auth_challenge returned.

walletAddress.description: The agent wallet that signed the challenge.

name: prepare_checkout
title: Prepare an order for the person to approve
